question: What teaching is said to have been told concerning the earth-moving good-eaters, and by whom?
premises: A teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by the earth-mover.
It is addressed to the beloved one.
inference: A teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by the earth-mover, O beloved one.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by the earth-mover, O beloved one.
